content: Hello, this is Maya from the Central City Clinic billing department. How may I assist you with your account today?
Hi Maya, I just sent a payment for my brother's hospital bill and want to make sure it goes through properly.
Of course. Can you confirm the patient's name and the payment method used, so I can check our records? For reference, I see a John Patel admitted under patient ID CC-11492.
Yes, John Patel is my brother. I used Zelle and sent $1,750 to billing@centralcityclinic.com about 15 minutes ago.

Thank you for confirming. I do see a Zelle transaction of $1,750 with reference code ZLL-63744, timestamped at 2:17pm, linked to billing@centralcityclinic.com. To ensure it's applied correctly, could you confirm if the sender's name was Priya Patel?
Yes, that's me, Priya Patel, and my number is 555-283-9921 in case you need it for the receipt.

Great, Priya. I've added your phone number, 555-283-9921, to the transaction notes. The payment is currently pending, but it should reflect on John's account within the next 30 minutes. I'll email the payment receipt to priya.patel92@gmail.com once it clears.
Thanks. Is there a way to speed this up? We're trying to get him discharged today.

I understand the urgency. Since you used Zelle, funds typically post quickly. I'll prioritize John Patel's file and notify you immediately via text at 555-283-9921 as soon as the $1,750 payment is confirmed. Let me know if you have any other concerns in the meantime.
